# Security Protocol & File Parser LibFuzzer Harness

Continuous fuzzing of input parsers (JSON, Markdown, network packets) using LLVM libFuzzer and AddressSanitizer (ASan).

## Invariants
- RUN_WITH_ADDRESS_SANITIZER_ASAN
- MINIMIZE_CRASH_CORPUS_REPRODUCERS
- ZERO_PANICS_ON_MALFORMED_INPUTS
